For more visibility, being heard and support!

You decide for yourself whether you want to tell your story, join in or simply listen for now.

Jede Spende stärkt Opferhilfe, Vernetzun.en: Every donation strengthens victim support, networking and awareness.

Jeden Tag erleben Menschen in unserer Ge.en: Every day, people in our society experience violence, exclusion and injustice – and far too often people look away. But we look closely. We stand up for those whose stories would otherwise go unheard: for victims and co-victims and for all those who no longer want to stay silent.

Wir geben Betroffenen eine Stimme, biete.en: We give those affected a voice, offer spaces for exchange, do educational work, create networks, share knowledge and fight for structural change. This is about individual fates that are not isolated cases, and about a system that we can change together.

Jede Spende ist ein Zeichen für Unterstü.en: Every donation is a sign of support and connection. With your donation you help not just one person, but many.
